Featured Match

Two unbeatens, and only one way out

Home
benditlikebergvall
2–0 · 195 pts
vs
Away
brendog2814
2–0 · 198 pts

benditlikebergvall and brendog2814 are the only teams still to lose, and they are separated by three points of scoring: 195.35 against 198.35. The difference is who they have played. brendog2814 has faced the two lowest totals of the season and conceded 93.00, the least in the league by 32 points; benditlikebergvall has already given up 157.20 and won both anyway. Erling Haaland and Kevin Schade are both home in GW3, City hosting Coventry and Brentford hosting Sunderland, while James Tarkowski gets Everton at home to United after his 21.00 in GW2. brendog2814's spread is the thinner one — Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Morgan Rogers both travel, to Brighton and to Arsenal. One of these records ends here.

Featured Match

The trade meets itself

Home
skoeiboy
1–1 · 201 pts
vs
Away
Flabiano9
1–1 · 163 pts

Three weeks ago Flabiano9 sent Youri Tielemans and 50 FAAB to skoeiboy for Sandro Tonali. In GW2 Tielemans returned 16.35 and Tonali 5.00, and now the two squads meet with both men on the pitch. Everything else about this pairing has run backwards as well: skoeiboy opened with 137.65, the biggest week of the season, then fell to 63.50; Flabiano9 opened with 64.35, the second-worst, then put up 98.45. Both are 1–1. Rayan Cherki and Antoine Semenyo give Flabiano9 two City starters at home to Coventry, the softest fixture on the board, while skoeiboy leans on Cole Palmer at Arsenal and Anthony Elanga at home to Bournemouth. The 50 FAAB is gone either way. Only the eleven is still arguable.
